display_name: Product Locked Ad Background Workflow V1
purpose: Keep the original product pixels locked while creating a studio-style advertising background, contact shadow, and final canvas composition.

inputs.product_image: File name inside ComfyUI/input. Prefer transparent PNG or product photo with clean background.
inputs.background_style: cosmetic_studio, pharma_blue_rank, luxury_stone, spring_clean, dark_premium, or warm_editorial.
inputs.product_scale: Visible alpha-bounded product size relative to canvas.
inputs.product_x_percent: Horizontal product anchor, 0.0 left to 1.0 right.
inputs.product_y_percent: Vertical product anchor, 0.0 top to 1.0 bottom.

product_safety.product_pixels: Original product RGB is only resized and pasted; no generative repaint is applied.
product_safety.label_logo: Preserved from the product source image.
product_safety.transparent_padding: Transparent canvas padding is cropped before the product is resized.
product_safety.risk: If the source has no alpha channel, the full rectangular image is treated as product.

next_versions.v2: Replace or enhance procedural background with Qwen/Flux background generation and add IC-Light relighting.
next_versions.v3: Add mask edge repair, detail transfer, upscale, and PSD/Figma handoff.
